title: About
description: About Will Qing, an Information Engineering undergraduate at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
heading: About me.

paragraphs: I’m Will, an undergraduate in Information Engineering at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My interests lie around machine learning, signals, and physical systems. I have also worked on optical computing.
Outside research, I spend most of my time reading, listening to music, and watching films and series. I’m also a Manchester United supporter and follow McLaren and Lando Norris in Formula 1.
